newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Nikkei futures end firm, upside limited.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Nikkei futures end firm, upside limited.

text.p: SIMEX Nikkei futures rebounded from early lows to end the week firmer after a fairly smooth settlement of March index futures and options in Osaka.

"In the morning, we were bearish because of the Dow's 160-point drop and we expected selling coupled with the SQ (special quotation) settlement for March," said a trader with a Japanese futures house.
He said the new benchmark June contract recovered after finding good support near its low of 17,440. The dollar's gains versus the yen also underpinned the market.
The Nikkei 225 June contract ended 130 points firmer at 17,840 on volume of 19,795 lots.
"When it reached the 17,400 level and didn't look like it was going any lower, people started to buy it back to cover their short positions," the trader said.
He said the contract would have difficulty climbing above the 17,900 and was likely to head lower next week to test support at 17,200.
The March MSCI Taiwan index contract ended at 350.2 against its opening 348.5 on volume of 837 lots.
